card.name: Inside brand and rare names
card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle of an unusual capitalized brand name or rare proper name, such as SY-M, NUL-IB-RY, Niinim-ä-ki or Berot-ral-stat. Often seen in all-caps drug names and warnings.

modes.label: All-caps brand names
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase brand name split into parts, such as NULIBRY or SYMVESS.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Start NUL<<IB>>RY if known or presumed MoCD Type

modes.label: SY- words in capitals
modes.description: The M after SY in capitalized warning headings, in brand names and in the word symptomatic.

modes.label: Rare names
modes.description: Middle piece of a rare surname, place or generic drug name.
modes.example: M. Gissler, M. Niinim<<ä>>ki, and E. Hemminki
